001package org.clafer.ir;
002
003import java.util.Arrays;
004import org.clafer.common.Check;
005import org.clafer.domain.Domain;
006
007/**
008 * Returns array[index].
009 *
010 * @author jimmy
011 */
012public class IrStringElement extends IrAbstractString {
013
014    private final IrStringExpr[] array;
015    private final IrIntExpr index;
016
017    IrStringElement(IrStringExpr[] array, IrIntExpr index,
018            Domain[] charDomains, Domain lengthDomain) {
019        super(charDomains, lengthDomain);
020        this.array = Check.noNullsNotEmpty(array);
021        this.index = Check.notNull(index);
022    }
023
024    public IrStringExpr[] getArray() {
025        return array;
026    }
027
028    public IrIntExpr getIndex() {
029        return index;
030    }
031
032    @Override
033    public <A, B> B accept(IrStringExprVisitor<A, B> visitor, A a) {
034        return visitor.visit(this, a);
035    }
036
037    @Override
038    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
039        if (obj instanceof IrStringElement) {
040            IrStringElement other = (IrStringElement) obj;
041            return Arrays.equals(array, other.array) && index.equals(other.index);
042        }
043        return false;
044    }
045
046    @Override
047    public int hashCode() {
048        return Arrays.hashCode(array) ^ index.hashCode();
049    }
050
051    @Override
052    public String toString() {
053        return Arrays.toString(array) + "[" + index + "]";
054    }
055}
